description.zh: 查询时间范围的开始时间，格式为时间戳，单位为秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 工作流任务节点ID。如何获取节点ID，请参见[ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~)。
description.en: The ID of the node on which the pipeline job is executed. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the node ID.
The offset from which the data is returned. Default value: 0.
The number of logs returned per page.

description.zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见[ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~)。
description.en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline job.

description.zh:
是否倒排，取值如下：
- false（默认值）：正序排列日志。
- true：倒序排列日志。
description.en:
Specifies whether the logs are sorted in descending order. Valid values:

*   false: The logs are sorted in ascending order. This is the default value.
*   true: The logs are sorted in descending order.

description.zh: 查询时间范围的结束时间，格式为时间戳，单位为秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID。
description.en: The ID of the shared pipeline job.

title.zh: 获取工作流任务节点日志
